authority.derivedCapturePolicy: PNG captures are reproducible inspection aids. The MOV SHA, decoded-frame index, and PTS remain the authority.

video.codecLongName: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

frameIndexing.decodedFrameIndexDefinition: Zero-based presentation-order index in ffprobe .frames; this is the n used by ffmpeg select=eq(n,index).
frameIndexing.ptsDefinition: best_effort_timestamp in the video time base 1/6000.

declaredVersusDecodedDiscrepancy.detail: The stream header declares 1980 frames, while FFmpeg 8.1.2 decodes 1976 presentation frames. The timeline also skips PTS 400 and 500 between 0.050000s and 0.100000s.
declaredVersusDecodedDiscrepancy.acceptanceRule: Never identify an anchor by declared ordinal alone; always retain decoded-frame index plus PTS.

frameIndexing.durationCaveat: The last decoded frame PTS is 32.950000s although the stream/container duration is 32.927833s; use each anchor's PTS rather than deriving it from total duration or average FPS.

evidence: The recording raster is exactly two times 1508x761 in each dimension.
QuickTime metadata identifies an Apple Mac15,6 capture on macOS 15.7.7, consistent with Retina backing pixels.

On 2026-07-28, the current authoritative site rendered at CSS 1508x761 placed the first landing-title line at x=405.046875, y=128, width=697.90625, height=86.3984375; its half-raster alignment matches the recording landing composition.
cssViewport.caveat: The MOV does not directly encode CSS viewport dimensions. This pair is accepted through exact raster scaling plus live-source layout cross-check.

devicePixelRatio.caveat: DPR is not stored as a dedicated MOV field; it is resolved jointly with the CSS viewport.

browserNameAndVersion.reason: No browser chrome or browser metadata is present in the recording.

inputDevice.reason: Pointer and scroll motion are visible, but the recording does not identify mouse versus trackpad.

timingPolicy.preReloadFrames: 0.000000s through approximately 0.883333s show an already-resolved page and are capture setup, not a loader target.
timingPolicy.loaderAndReveal: The apparent reload/reveal after approximately 0.900000s is elapsed-time evidence.
timingPolicy.journey: Motion after the landing exit is user-scroll-controlled. Recording timestamps are seek anchors and must not be interpreted as authored scroll durations or normalized journey progress.
timingPolicy.localEffects: The recording shows repeating landing-route and field-pulse states, but cannot by itself separate elapsed-time, scroll, and pointer ownership.

commands.decodedFrameCount: ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_frames -show_entries frame=best_effort_timestamp,best_effort_timestamp_time,key_frame,pict_type -of json docs/vectrfl_recording.mov | jq '.frames | length'
